ems_standard.evidence_quote: The standard ISO 50006 [4] deﬁnes EnPIs as energy related key performance indicators (KPIs) describing the energy consumption, energy use and energy efﬁciency of a system, process and equipment.

evidence_quote: EnPIs such as the hydraulic efﬁciency for pumps (∆pQ/Pel with p: Pressure, Q: Volumetric ﬂow, Pel: Electrical energy [21]) or the heat dissipated per electrical energy for dry cooling towers (Pth/Pel with: Pth: Thermal energy) are embedded in the models.

The concept comprises a standardized, manufacturer-independent, object-oriented and machine-readable data exchange format for structural data of supply technology and behavior models as well as a standardized interface for the use of the data exchange format in the target platform like a MES or EMS.
